newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesia Cilacap crude tank fire doused Monday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Cilacap crude tank fire doused Monday.

text.p: A fire which set a crude storage tank at Indonesia's Cilacap refinery ablaze on Monday was doused within 20 minutes, trading sources said on Tuesday.
They said that operations at the 300,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery was not affected by the fire.
Traders said the fire was sparked by lightning but damage was limited to one storage tank.
Brokers said the swaps gas oil market firmed marginally Tuesday afternoon on fears that the Cilacap refinery operations might be affected by the fire, despite overnight losses in crude values.

A similar lightning strike in October last year damaged seven oil products storage tanks and led to the shutdown of the refinery. This prompted state-oil firm Pertamina to import large volumes of diesel and kerosene during the end of last year.
This incident and the winter purchases had led to spiralling diesel and kerosene prices then.
As a result of last year's fire, the Cilacap refinery was operating at 70 percent of capacity for several months.
